Community governance is a philosophy that brings the understanding that government is an institution but governance is a process and that process creates a mutual understanding of the part of each municipal department and community based organization plays to create neighborhoods that are safe within our city.

It requires all stakeholders led by city administration rather than the police administration to come together and develop strategic and operational plans to repair deteriorated neighborhoods, develop services for citizens and establish goals for the future in a coordinated way.

The community governance model requires organizational and cultural changes to take place, which distribute the leadership of community safety from being the sole responsibility of the police to spreading the responsibility formally across the corporation.
